method.browser: Chrome extension browser1 with native Google Chrome app UI
method.scope: DOM-backed canvas.dataset.frame/motion, document.visibilityState/hidden, play-toggle aria-pressed and displayed signal/status text. Native Chrome tab UI selected state was independently observed.
method.note: cua.getTab or browser handle selection was not used as proof of a native tab switch. Both Sound and blank were explicitly clicked in the native Chrome tab strip.

single_window_minimize_followup.window_scope: The owned Sound tab alone was moved through native Chrome tab context menu『タブを新しいウィンドウに移動』. Native AX confirmed a new window containing only the selected Sound tab. No unrelated user tab was moved or minimized intentionally.
single_window_minimize_followup.native_action: After a native app-state refresh, Command-M was sent to the dedicated Sound window. Native AX/screenshot did not expose a reliable minimized flag. A Dock UI query intended to confirm minimization stalled in the CUA service for1216.596 seconds and returned timeoutReached. No page DOM was read during that interval.
single_window_minimize_followup.restore: The native Chrome Window menu listed Sound Studies as a separate window. Its own item was selected to restore/bring forward that dedicated window, without selecting or modifying another user's tab contents.
single_window_minimize_followup.interpretation: The aggregate delta is approximately60fps over the whole attempt, and play remained true before manual cleanup. No near-zero-frame interval or automatic playback stop was observed. The actual minimized/hidden condition was not independently established, so this is not recorded as a hidden-state implementation FAIL or PASS.
single_window_minimize_followup.tool_limit: The Dock lookup's long service timeout prevented the planned10-second coordination window. The followup was abandoned after restoration; no further Dock, focus-emulation or window-minimization investigation was attempted.

native_only_followup.rationale: A separate native-only window was tried once to avoid binding a browser automation target. This is an observation of that native UI path; it does not retroactively change the failed document.visibilityState preconditions in the earlier attempts.
native_only_followup.creation: Native Chrome File→新規ウインドウ. Entered Sound v6 URL through the native omnibox. This new Sound page was never obtained through cua.createBrowserTab, cua.getTab, browser/getTab or playwright/evaluate. Only Google Chrome App AX, clicks and keys were used for its page.

before.native_UI: Sound Studies01 Playing; 音を停止する toggle1; Emberを再生しています。音量はいつでも調整できます。
before.telemetry_limit: The displayed telemetry was expanded. Its AX text exposed rolling active_render statistics in an earlier read, but no usable total canvas frame counter could be obtained. Rolling20-second count was not treated as a monotonic frame total.

native_only_followup.tab_leave: Native Command-T created a task-owned New Tab in the same single-window test. AX showed New Tab selected/on and Sound off. clock.sleep completed5005.6ms while no Sound page DOM/browser APIs were touched. Native Command-W then closed only that task-created blank/new tab.

after_return_before_manual_stop.native_UI: Sound Studies01 Stopped; 音を再生する toggle0; タブを離れたため音を停止しました。再生ボタンで再開できます。

native_only_followup.interval_scope: Includes native steps and state readbacks around the planned5-second quiet interval; it is not a precise document-hidden duration.
native_only_followup.cleanup: Did not click play again. Explicitly paused motion, confirmed Motion paused and Stopped/play0, then closed the task-created native-only Sound window with Command-W. Native Chrome returned to the existing owned editorial-v3 tab. No user-created tab was closed.

claims.document_hidden_direct_observation: NOT_RUN — no browser binding was used
claims.continuous_frame_count_while_hidden: NOT_RUN — total frame counter not exposed in native AX

limitations: The cause of the native-selection/document-visibility discrepancy was not established. No undocumented browser command, script override or broader user setting change was attempted to force it.
The continued frame/play states do not prove a hidden-state implementation bug because the browser reported the document as visible.
Playback state and Chrome's playback indication were observed. No physical audio-output capture or audio-node inspection was performed.
This real-browser attempt is separate from source/VM visibility tests and must not be recorded as their live equivalent.
evidence_retention: Native Chrome AX selected-tab state and the two DOM-backed snapshots are retained in the CUA transcript. No screenshot/video artifact is claimed.
